sections.name: body
sections.value:
Security verdict, #308 (F256), at e637deb24f68674b418a5dd6972a6953dc35313a: PASS. I reviewed the one commit against main 653f90ef, statically. CI 5/5 green (check(22), check(24), delivers, rust-lint, rust-test), CLEAN. I ran no build and no live canary.

S306-003 is CLOSED. runtime_model now matches every result of catalog.shows(native, footer): Ok(true) passes, Ok(false) is Disagree, and Err is the new Unchecked. Unchecked covers omp models failing or timing out after 5 s, bad output, and no catalog row for the native selector. canary_command refuses Unchecked with details.native_model, details.footer_model and details.catalog_error. The cross-product I asked for is now the test a_catalog_that_cannot_check_the_footer_refuses: stale native Opus with a GPT footer and the catalog down, native Sol with its own name and the catalog down, and an unlisted native selector.

This is a brake (the AGENTS.md test). Removing the check would let more canaries pass, and it only ever adds a refusal. Its one input is the catalog's answer, and that can only stop a pass, never make one.

It fails safe:
- Every runtime_model refusal returns Err before service.mutation.lock(). I read canary_command around lines 2205-2245: no state is written and nothing is persisted.
- The refusal goes back in the HTTP envelope to the authenticated caller only (error.response at the dispatch, line ~634).
- An outage means the canary refuses and can be retried. Nothing is killed or tombstoned.
- A footer with no model still leaves native standing with no launch. The panicking no_launch catalog in native_evidence_needs_no_footer_resolution proves it.

Refusal details leak nothing sensitive:
- catalog_error is the omp_inventory_with error text, which carries one of: the fixed argv text, an io error, "timed out after 5 seconds", the JSON parse cause, or omp's trimmed stderr, plus the selector name.
- The same text already reaches the caller on main, through the footer-resolve path (catalog.resolve(footer).await?).
- It goes back to the same-user caller (C33) and is not written to the spine, an output or a governed repo.
- native_model and footer_model are model names only. They hold no paths, tokens or prompt text.
- Residual, not a finding: omp's stderr is not size-capped in the details. That is the same exposure the resolve path already has.

Cost: unchanged. omp.models runs at most once per OMP canary, and only when its footer names a model. There is no new launch site.
